title: DataPilot AI
tag: Conversational spreadsheet analysis and Gmail automation
body:
Evidence-backed n8n prototype.
Owner: AnyalstRushi.
Original workflow export pending.
notes: Introduce it as a prototype, not a company deployment.

title: The user problem
body:
Spreadsheet questions and report communication create manual handoffs.
Chat can coordinate retrieval and communication.
Time savings and ROI remain unmeasured.
notes: Explain the intended value without fabricated impact metrics.

title: Observed architecture
body:
Chat Trigger -> AI Agent.
Anthropic model and Simple Memory support the agent.
Google Sheets and Gmail are connected tools.
Tool invocation is not guaranteed on every request.
notes: Describe the main connection separately from supporting sub-nodes.

title: What is demonstrated
body:
Spreadsheet retrieval is visible.
One response displays 43 data rows plus a header.
A static-body email is received.
A generated analytics email is not yet verified.
notes: The 43-row response and larger booking source are different observations.

title: The large-data failure
body:
Sheets returned 20,407 items.
The next model request failed: request entity too large.
Exact provider limits were not established.
Successful retrieval does not imply safe LLM processing.
notes: Do not invent a byte limit, context capacity, or service error code.

title: Input and memory context
body:
One manual agent screen shows undefined chatInput.
Simple Memory also reports an error.
Test through workflow chat and inspect the detailed node error.
notes: The exact memory cause is unconfirmed.

title: Email delivery vs report correctness
body:
Gmail success and actual receipt are separate checks.
The delivered body is a static greeting.
Next test: receive the exact approved data-derived report.
notes: Do not call the static greeting an analytics report.

title: Calculate first, explain second
body:
Read bounded data and validate coverage.
Compute counts, sums, and categories outside the LLM.
Give the model one compact summary.
Preview, approve, send once, and record the outcome.
notes: This architecture is proposed, not yet implemented.

title: A measurable synthetic fixture
body:
8 fictional data rows; 5 successful bookings.
Booking-value sum: 1,000; all-row mean: 125.
Successful-booking mean: 200.
Currency unspecified; original workflow test pending.
notes: Local fixture tests are not integration tests.

title: Privacy and action safety
body:
No raw screenshots, source records, or personal contacts published.
Inspect workflow exports before sharing.
Approval, duplicate protection, and memory isolation are proposed.
No audit or certification is claimed.
notes: Original dataset rights and credential scopes are not established.

title: Delivery gates
body:
Reproduce: original export and fresh import.
Report: exact metrics and dynamic email receipt.
Protect: approval and duplicate prevention.
Scale: compact model input and large-source retest.
notes: No deadlines or production SLAs are committed.

title: Engineering over hype
body:
A useful agent needs bounded data, validated results, and controlled actions.
Lead with actual evidence and honest limitations.
Next milestone: verified spreadsheet-derived email report.
notes: Use the project report for interview notes and technical sources.
